**Product Manager – AI & EdTech**  
**Location:** Remote  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Us**  
Champ Code Academy is a Singapore-founded EdTech company incubated by NUS Enterprise, on a mission to empower the next generation of creators through coding and AI.

We are building an AI-powered learning platform that enables children to turn their ideas into real games and digital creations, combining AI, gamification and interactive learning to redefine how children learn technology.

As we scale our platform internationally, we are looking for a curious, ambitious and execution-driven individual to join our product team and help shape the future of our products.

**About the Role**  
You will work directly with the founders and collaborate closely with our engineering, design, curriculum and operations teams to turn ideas into meaningful product experiences.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You will be involved across the entire product development lifecycle — from identifying user problems and conceptualizing solutions to launching features, measuring performance and continuously improving the product.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Product Discovery & Strategy**

* Understand user needs, behaviors and pain points through research, interviews and data analysis.
* Conduct competitor research and identify opportunities for product innovation.
* Proactively propose new features and improvements that drive user engagement, retention and business growth.
* Support the development and prioritization of the product roadmap.

**Product Design & Development**

* Translate business objectives and user needs into clear product requirements, user stories and user flows.
* Develop wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes to communicate product concepts.

**Product Execution**

* Coordinate across teams to ensure alignment and timely execution.
* Conduct user acceptance testing to ensure features meet product requirements and quality standards.
* Identify product gaps, usability issues and areas for improvement.

**Product Analytics & Growth**

* Define and track key product performance metrics.
* Analyse user behaviour, engagement, adoption and retention.
* Design and evaluate experiments to validate product hypotheses.
* Translate insights into actionable product improvements.

**Requirements**

* 0–3 years of experience in product management, business analysis, software development, UX design or a related field.
* Strong analytical, logical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong product sense and an ability to understand problems from the user’s perspective.
* Ability to translate ambiguous ideas into clear, actionable requirements.
* Comfortable working with data, technology and AI tools.
* Highly proactive, resourceful and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong sense of ownership and attention to detail.

Exceptional fresh graduates with demonstrated product thinking and a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply.

* Experience working in a startup, SaaS, EdTech, gaming or consumer technology company.

* Experience building personal projects, digital products or AI-powered applications.
* Interest in gamification, behavioural design and user engagement.

* Direct exposure to founders and meaningful influence over product direction.
* Opportunity to build an AI-powered product with international reach.

* A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with opportunities for accelerated career growth.
* Fully remote working arrangements.

We value curiosity, resourcefulness and the ability to execute over years of experience or formal qualifications.

title: Product Manager - FMCG
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and hands-on **FMCG Product Manager** who can take complete ownership of product development, new product launches, brand management, and market growth.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire product lifecycle, starting from identifying new product opportunities and conducting market research to product development, manufacturing coordination, branding, packaging, pricing, market launch, and sales growth.

The role requires practical experience in launching FMCG products through both offline and online channels, including e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant platforms.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving product execution, coordinating with multiple departments, and converting product ideas into commercially successful products.

Key Responsibilities1. Market Research & Product Identification

* Conduct market research to identify new product opportunities, emerging trends, and consumer requirements.
* Analyse competitor products, pricing, packaging, positioning, and market performance.
* Identify potential FMCG product categories and recommend new products based on market demand and business opportunities.
* Evaluate product feasibility, target audiences, market potential, and expected profitability.
* Develop product concepts and business proposals for new product launches.

2. Product Development & Manufacturing Coordination

* Manage the complete product development process from concept to final product.
* Coordinate with R&D, manufacturing, procurement, and quality control teams for product formulation and development.
* Work on product specifications, ingredients, quality standards, costing, and production requirements.
* Coordinate product sampling, testing, packaging development, and final approvals.
* Ensure products meet quality requirements, cost targets, and planned launch timelines.

3. Branding, Packaging & Pricing

* Manage product naming, branding, positioning, packaging design, and label development.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, creative agencies, and marketing teams for product packaging and branding.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on manufacturing costs, competitor pricing, market positioning, and profit margins.
* Ensure packaging and product communication are aligned with applicable regulatory and labelling requirements.

4. New Product Launch & Go-to-Market Strategy

* Independently plan and execute new FMCG product launches.
* Develop and implement Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for new products.
* Coordinate all pre-launch and post-launch activities to ensure successful market entry.
* Plan product availability, distribution, promotional activities, and sales channel readiness.
* Monitor initial market response and implement strategies to improve product acceptance and sales.

5. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

* Manage end-to-end product launches and operations across e-commerce platforms.
* Handle product listings, catalog creation, product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and SEO optimization.
* Manage product presence across Amazon, Flipkart, JioMart, and other relevant online marketplaces.
* Coordinate marketplace promotions, advertising, discounts, and online visibility campaigns.
* Monitor product rankings, customer reviews, ratings, conversion rates, and online sales performance.
* Identify opportunities to expand online distribution and improve marketplace sales.

6. Offline Sales & Distribution Management

* Work with sales teams to establish products in offline markets.
* Coordinate with distributors, dealers, retailers, and channel partners for product distribution.
* Develop strategies for retail penetration, product availability, and market expansion.
* Support sales teams with product knowledge, pricing information, and promotional plans.
* Monitor product-wise sales performance across different distribution channels.

7. Marketing & Brand Growth

* Work closely with marketing teams to plan and execute product marketing strategies.
* Coordinate digital marketing, social media campaigns, advertising, and promotional activities.
* Develop product communication and marketing content in collaboration with creative teams.
* Identify brand-building opportunities to increase product awareness and market demand.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements to increase sales and brand visibility.

8. Product Performance & Business Management

* Monitor product-wise sales, revenue, profit margins, and overall business performance.
* Manage product costing, pricing, budgets, and profitability.
* Analyse customer feedback, market response, and sales data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate inventory planning, demand forecasting, and supply chain requirements.
* Prepare regular product performance reports and present business updates to management.
* Take corrective actions to improve product performance and achieve business growth targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in FMCG Product Management, Product Development, Brand Management, or New Product Launch.
* Proven hands-on experience in successfully launching FMCG products in the market.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, from concept development to commercial launch.
* Practical experience in product branding, packaging, costing, pricing, and market positioning.
* Hands-on knowledge of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Understanding of marketplace SEO, product listing optimization, catalog management, and online sales operations.
* Experience in offline distribution, retail markets, and sales channel development.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market research, competitor analysis, and FMCG market dynamics.
* Excellent coordination, communication, negotiation, and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple products and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with a focus on sales, profitability, and business growth.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates who have independently handled FMCG products from initial concept to successful market launch.
* Experience in launching new brands or product categories.
* Candidates with practical exposure to both e-commerce marketplaces and offline retail distribution.
* Experience working with manufacturing units, vendors, packaging agencies, and marketing teams.
* Candidates who can take ownership of product execution rather than only handling planning or coordination.

Key Performance Expectations (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated on:

* Successful development and launch of new products.
* Timely execution of product launches.
* Growth in product-wise sales and revenue.
* E-commerce sales and marketplace performance.
* Offline market penetration and distribution expansion.
* Product profitability and margin management.
* Brand visibility and market acceptance.

**Important:** This is an end-to-end product ownership role. The selected candidate will be expected to independently drive assigned products from market research and product development to launch, distribution, e-commerce operations, sales performance, and long-term business growth.

**1. About iDream Education**  
**Vision:** Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.  
**Belief:** We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being’s fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.  
**Mission:** To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio-economic status.iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline & online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:• iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms• iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs• iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning• iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring• iPrep App for a one-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and WebThrough iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to **Learn Unlimited.**Company website: **www.idreameducation.org** | iPrep website: www.iprep.in

**2. Role Summary**  
The Product Manager at iDream Education sits at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and the field. You will define what gets built, ensure it is built right, and make sure it solves real problems for the students, teachers, and administrators who use our products every day.You will work across both internal tools and the iPrep suite of products — partnering closely with design, engineering, ops, content, and sales, as well as with field counterparts — leading roadmap planning and prioritisation in close partnership with the founders.

**3. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Own the Spec Layer**

* Translate requests from ops, content, sales, and marketing into clear, structured product requirements before they reach engineering.
* Define acceptance criteria, timelines, and priorities for every piece of work entering the engineering pipeline.
* Eliminate ambiguity as a default — no ticket moves to development without a written spec.

**Bridge Design and Engineering**

* Work closely with the design team to drive iterations to finality — own sign-off gates so engineering always builds against confirmed designs.
* Be the single point of accountability for design-to-development handoffs.
* Reduce rework by making design decisions explicit and time-bound.

**Stakeholder Interface**

* Be the primary point of contact for internal teams — ops, content, sales, marketing — channelling their needs into the product process.
* Interface with field counterparts and school-level stakeholders to surface ground realities and unvoiced user needs.
* Represent product context clearly across very different audiences — from engineers to field coordinators.

**Roadmap Planning and Prioritisation**

* Lead roadmap planning in close partnership with the founders — synthesising inputs from internal teams, field signals, and usage data.
* Identify unvoiced opportunities: gaps that no one is articulating yet but that the data or field context reveals.
* Work with our data analysts to bring usage evidence into prioritisation discussions — not just instinct.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:** Graduate in any discipline; a background in Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. However, candidates with a strong track record in product management, product strategy, or cross-functional product development will also be considered regardless of their specific degree.  
**Experience:** 3–8 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a technology, SaaS, EdTech, or digital product environment. A proven track record includes successfully defining product requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving product launches, and delivering measurable business and user outcomes through data-driven product decisions.

**Other Requirements:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet product delivery timelines. Strong collaboration with engineering, design, business, and other stakeholders is essential. This is primarily an office-based role located in Gurugram, Haryana, with minimal travel as required for customer interactions, workshops, or business meetings.

**5. Key Skills & Competencies**

* 3–8 years of total relevant experience, with at least 1–2 years directly in a product team (as PM, Associate PM, Business Analyst, or similar adjacent role).
* You have been a member of a product team — you understand how good product development works from the inside, even if PM wasn’t your exact title.
* You write with structure and clarity. Your specs, briefs, and updates leave no room for misinterpretation.
* You are comfortable with data — you can pull the right numbers, read them honestly, and use them to make a case or change your mind.
* You thrive in environments where influence matters more than authority. You can align people who don’t report to you.
* You are energised by working closely with founders — you see it as an advantage, not a constraint.
* You genuinely care about the problem: quality education reaching every child, regardless of where they grow up.
* You are coachable and self-aware — you know what you don’t know, and you’re not threatened by it.

**6. What We're Looking For — Values & Culture Fit**

* **Integrity:** Makes transparent, data-driven product decisions and takes ownership of outcomes.
* **Impact:** Builds products that solve real customer problems and drive measurable business value.
* **Excellence:** Continuously improves the product through user insights, data, and innovation.
* **Collaboration:** Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams to deliver successful product outcomes.

**7. Why Join Us**  
This is a high-ownership role at the center of our product development, where your work directly bridges the gap between field realities and engineering execution. You will partner closely with the founders to shape the roadmap of the iPrep suite, ensuring our products solve real-world problems for students and teachers across India. Join us to build, measure, and scale solutions that make "Unlimited Learning" a reality for every child, while advancing your product leadership in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Wego**
--------------

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We don't just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**
----------------

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, what's next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are**
---------------

### **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

### **Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

### **This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **You'd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

**Product Manager – Organic Social**

**About us:**

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target’s Product teams are at the very heart of what delights our guests, time after time. We’re accountable for delivering the business outcomes that enable our operations and delight Target guests. Together, we tackle a backlog inclusive of all product, technology and design work.

Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work.

Social platforms are where guests increasingly discover, engage with, and are inspired by Target. In this role, you will directly influence how Target shows up organically across social platforms—including, but not limited to, TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—driving more relevant, engaging guest experiences and unlocking growth across an ever-evolving social ecosystem. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead innovation across Organic Social, a critical foundation powering brand awareness, guest engagement, and discovery. This role will own the strategy and execution of the tools and capabilities that enable Target to manage, listen to, and optimize its organic social presence at scale.

You will operate at the intersection of social platforms, content, data, and guest insights, driving improvements in social publishing, listening, engagement, and measurement to elevate the guest experience and grow Target’s presence across social channels.

What You’ll Do

* Own the product vision and roadmap for organic social capabilities, focusing on scalability, efficiency, and guest impact across all social platforms
* Build and scale capabilities that enable teams to manage Target’s organic social presence across multiple platforms, including but not limited to TikTok, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Pinterest, and YouTube—covering tools that support content planning, publishing, scheduling, asset management, and approval workflows
* Work closely with data & analytics teams to deliver social listening capabilities to monitor guest conversations, sentiment, trends, and brand mentions
* Drive optimization of organic social experiences through performance analytics, cross-platform reporting, and test-and-learn experimentation to improve reach, engagement, and conversion
* Support community management and guest engagement capabilities, including comment and message moderation
* Partner with social platforms to integrate APIs and emerging features (e.g., shoppable content, product tagging, creator tools), ensuring Target stays ahead of platform changes
* Manage contracts and agreements associated with social platforms and related vendors, including renewals, terms, and compliance, in partnership with legal, procurement, and vendor management teams
* Embed brand safety, governance, and compliance standards into social tools and workflows
* Manage social platform authorization and access across the enterprise, including intake, review, and approval of access requests, role-based permissions, and periodic access audits to protect Target’s brand accounts
* Develop and evolve measurement and attribution capabilities to quantify the impact of organic social on guest engagement, traffic, and sales

* Translate complex social platform and stakeholder needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and scalable solutions

You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.

You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
  
  
You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.

description:
**Job Purpose:**

As the Staff,AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 18+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

.

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

How We Do It

From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is advancing smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics and time of use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAITM energy analytics provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

For more information, please visit-

Website: www.bidgely.com

Blog: bidgely.com/blog

How You Fit In

You will act as the GM of your problem space, balancing customer empathy, product excellence, and business impact. You are data-obsessed, have a bias-to-action, and fluent in transforming insights into scalable CX outcomes. Standout candidates will be AI-native—comfortable articulating an ML-powered alue proposition and using GenAI tools for speed and scale.

You will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, with responsibility for the end-to-end product lifecycle, from roadmap and design to launch and enablement.

What You’ll Do

* Own a customer problem area end‐to‐end: define the vision, strategy, metrics, and delivery to the market; shape a 6-12‐month roadmap.
* Discover & prioritize through market analysis, customer interviews, data mining, and experiment results.
* Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels.
* Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

* Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
* Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives.
* Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing.

What Makes You Successful

* 4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product.
* Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike.
* Proven strategy execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes.
* Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing.
* Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs.
* Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries.

Nice to Have

* Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling.
* Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews.

Core Competencies

* Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction.
* Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters.
* Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

* Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

* Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress.
* Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike.
* Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar.

Why Join Bidgely?

* Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

* Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design.
* Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently.
* Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise.
* Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Science & Measurement
description:
**Job Description**

**NIQ Activate** is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Data Science & Measurement to manage the portfolio of data-science models and measurement capabilities used across Promotion Planning, Promotion Effectiveness, Retail Media, and Personalization.

**This is a technical product-management role, not a model-development role.** The successful candidate will partner with Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, and Engineering to maintain the model inventory, define clear requirements, identify opportunities for standardization and reuse, and manage migration from legacy or product-specific models toward shared portfolio capabilities.

The role requires sufficient technical depth to understand model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, and limitations. Data Science retains ownership of methodology selection, model development, scientific testing, and validation.

Key responsibilities

* **Model inventory and documentation:** Maintain an inventory of models and measurement capabilities across the four product areas, including purpose, usage, required data, inputs, outputs, ownership, versions, dependencies, limitations, and lifecycle status.
* **Gap, duplication, and modernization assessment:** Identify missing capabilities, overlapping or inconsistent approaches, legacy models, and opportunities for competitive parity, differentiation, modernization, partnership, or retirement.
* **Standardization and reuse:** Identify opportunities to standardize models, methodologies, interfaces, terminology, inputs, outputs, and documentation across the portfolio.
* **Migration roadmap:** Define and manage the path from legacy or product-specific models toward standardized and reusable portfolio capabilities, including sequencing, dependencies, risks, and adoption.
* **Requirements definition:** Partner with domain Product Managers and Commercial teams to translate customer, market, and product needs into clear data-science and measurement requirements, use cases, expected outputs, constraints, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* **Prioritization and roadmap management:** Prioritize model and measurement needs based on customer value, commercial opportunity, product strategy, technical feasibility, delivery dependencies, and reuse potential.
* **Industry and best-practice research:** Research competitor capabilities, industry approaches, methodology trends, and applicable standards, and translate the findings into practical product recommendations.
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Connect Product Management, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, and Architecture to align decisions, delivery plans, technical dependencies, and product integration.
* **Model lifecycle and product integration:** Coordinate capabilities from requirement through development, integration, adoption, migration, replacement, and retirement, ensuring changes are reflected in product workflows, documentation, KPI definitions, and customer-facing experiences.
* **Adoption and stakeholder communication:** Track whether capabilities are adopted and creating expected value, and clearly communicate model purpose, assumptions, limitations, dependencies, migration plans, and product implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Experience:** 6+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with data-intensive, analytical, measurement, AI/ML, or decision-support products.
* **Technical product management:** Demonstrated ability to translate customer and business needs into clear, delivery-ready requirements for Data, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
* **Model and measurement fluency:** Working knowledge of concepts such as baselines, forecasting, optimization, incrementality, causal inference, attribution, segmentation, propensity, recommendations, and experiment design.
* **Technical understanding:** Ability to discuss model inputs, outputs, assumptions, dependencies, confidence, limitations, and intended use without being the hands-on model developer.
* **Portfolio thinking:** Experience identifying duplication, reusable capabilities, standardization opportunities, common interfaces, and migration paths across multiple products.
* **Research and product judgment:** Ability to assess industry practices and competitor capabilities and balance customer value, commercial opportunity, feasibility, reuse, effort, and time to value.
* **Roadmap and cross-functional leadership:** Experience managing priorities, dependencies, trade-offs, and sequencing across Product, Commercial, Data, Data Science, Engineering, Architecture, and customer-facing teams.
* **Communication:** Ability to translate technical concepts into clear product, commercial, and customer language and facilitate decisions across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Education and domain experience:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical, analytical, or business discipline, or equivalent experience. Experience in retail analytics, promotion, retail media measurement, personalization, revenue growth management, or marketing measurement is preferred.
* **Delivery methods:** Experience with agile delivery, PI planning or comparable scaled planning, Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PowerPoint.

description:

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**Our Impact**
--------------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.  
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As the Senior Product Manager for Account Integrity, you will make sure every account on HighLevel is authentic and uses the platform as intended. You will own the strategy and roadmap for preventing fake account creation, bots and fake traffic, SMS abuse, email abuse, affiliate and benefits abuse, and the handling of third-party abuse complaints.

  

Abuse on HighLevel shows up on many surfaces at once: signup, public forms, messaging, affiliates, funnels and websites, domains, and AI agents. You will build the detection layer, a shared definition of an abusive account, and the graduated enforcement system that stops abuse early while keeping friction off legitimate businesses.

  

You will set requirements and shared standards for integrity across the platform, and partner with the engineering teams that own each surface to build on work they already have in flight. Success in this role depends on strong cross-team leadership, crisp prioritization, and the ability to make a data-backed case for integrity work across many roadmaps.

This role sits on the Trust & Safety product team and shares a common detection, trust-scoring, and enforcement platform with the Account Security and Payment Risk verticals.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Account Integrity across signup, forms, messaging, affiliates, hosting, domains, and AI features.
* Define a shared definition of an abusive or inauthentic account, and drive the Account Integrity North Star along with its input and counter metrics.
* Build signup and onboarding defenses: device, browser, and network fingerprinting, bot detection, velocity limits, and re-entry prevention for banned actors.
* Drive controls that prevent messaging abuse and toll fraud, such as volume and destination limits and spend ceilings, in partnership with the messaging and product teams.
* Define permission limits that unlock abusable capabilities, such as messaging at scale, payments, and payouts, as an account builds history and verifies who it is.
* Own graduated enforcement capabilities with clear appeal paths and audit trails.
* Build intake, routing, and SLAs for abuse and takedown reports.
* Partner with Affiliates, Finance, and Payments to detect affiliate and benefits abuse before commissions and credits are paid.
* Work with Support/CX on investigator tooling, playbooks, and the operational model for integrity reviews.
* Run a weekly review of abuse caught and missed, false positives and appeals, time to takedown, and the dollar and customer cost of each.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 6+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of trust & safety, fraud, abuse prevention, integrity, or risk products.
* Experience building abuse detection, risk scoring, bot mitigation, or automated enforcement systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of platform abuse patterns: fake accounts, bots, SMS pumping and toll fraud, phishing and credential harvesting, promotion and affiliate abuse.
* Proven ability to lead through influence: driving priorities across engineering teams you do not manage.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable writing SQL, defining labels and metrics, and reasoning about precision, recall, and false positive cost.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder management across Engineering, Support, Legal, Finance, and senior leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Experience with onboarding or growth products.
* Experience with abuse of generative AI products and agent safety controls.

**Core KPIs**
-------------

* Volume of accounts showing abusive behavior with financial impact.
* Reduction in fake signups and trials, SMS pumping volume and cost, and affiliate fraud losses.
* Median time to enforce.
* Share of abuse detected proactively rather than through customer, vendor, or third-party reports.
* False positive rate, appeal overturn rate, and support tickets driven by enforcement.
* Abuse report intake SLA and operational efficiency.

**Why Join HighLevel?**
-----------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

  

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. title: Sr Product Manager - Payments Platform
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**About the role**

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Reliability.** Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

* **Corridor and market design**. Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

* **Integration standards.**You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

* **Resilience.** Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

* **AI and agentic payment flows**. This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

### **Requirements**

* Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

* Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

* You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

* 3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

**The Opportunity**

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

**How We’ll Measure You**

* Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

* Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

* Integration delivery against committed dates.

* Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), which includes Multichannel Commerce Fulfillment (MCCF), lets merchants use Amazon’s fulfilment and logistics network to reach customers wherever they shop: their own websites, social commerce, other marketplaces and wholesale. Our vision is to enable every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. Through Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF), Buy with Prime (BwP), Multi-Channel Distribution (MCD) and Warehousing & Logistics, merchants keep products in stock, ship faster and more reliably, and lower their costs. For over 20 years Amazon has helped small and medium-sized businesses grow on Amazon; ASCS is how we help merchants of every size grow beyond it.  
  
As ASCS scales, how merchants find, choose and get more out of it matters as much as what it offers. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager–Technical (Sr. PMT) to shape how ASCS grows with merchants: understanding why merchants who would benefit are not yet using our services, building the products and platforms that change that, and proving what actually moves the business. You will pair strategic vision with hands-on execution, working across engineering, business, finance and data science teams to build products fundamental to Amazon’s future.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
> Product strategy & direction: Continuously assess the needs of our customers and partners in defining and evolving the product and business strategy. Identify where ASCS services create the most value for merchants and translate those insights into a clear, differentiated product direction across marketing and pricing surfaces.  
> Roadmap planning: Deliver world-class innovation in features, usability, and performance in a consistent release cadence. Be the internal and external authority for your program, driving value-based prioritisation from concept to launch to maximise ROI.  
> Requirements definition: Develop comprehensive product plans incorporating merchant needs, competitive context, and business objectives. Produce high-quality requirements docs and manage scope to deliver key capabilities on time.  
> Technical collaboration: Partner with engineering to craft BRDs, influence the design and architecture of technical solutions, and make informed trade-off decisions that balance merchant impact with implementation complexity.  
> AI & productivity leverage: Apply AI tools to meaningfully accelerate product development from drafting and iterating on requirement document, merchant-facing messaging, to customer research, modelling pricing scenarios, and generating campaign briefs. You will actively identify where AI can compress timelines and improve output quality across the product lifecycle, and serve as a proponent of AI adoption within your cross-functional teams.  
  
A day in the life  
> Collaborate with GTM, Sales, User Research, Tech, Finance, and Operations to define strategy, vision, and features for MCF and ASCS adoption.  
> Own the product backlog and BRDs across marketing and pricing workstreams; prioritize and make feature trade-offs that maximize merchant adoption and ROI.  
> Deliver products end-to-end across Engineering, Legal, Information Security, UX, and Finance from concept through launch.  
> Design, launch, and iterate on lifecycle automation and targeted campaigns to engage and convert unmanaged merchants at scale.  
> Communicate charter vision, roadmap, and business impact to senior leadership  
  
About the team  
  
ASCS helps merchants of every size reach customers on any channel through Multi-Channel Fulfillment, Buy with Prime, Multi-Channel Distribution and Warehousing & Logistics. The ASCS Monetisation team owns how this business earns while keeping merchants’ trust. We set what merchants pay through rate cards, fees, discounts, incentives and negotiated pricing. We make merchants whole when inventory or orders are lost, damaged or returned. And we decide how merchants are invoiced and collected from, extending flexible payment terms without avoidable bad debt. Every decision must be calculated correctly, posted accurately, explained clearly and measured for real impact.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
